Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Ms. Sadaf, learned counsel for the 
petitioner.
2. Mr. Devendra Singh Bohra and Mr. 
Devendra Pant, learned Standing Counsel 
for the State of Uttarakhand/respondent 
Nos.1 to 6.
3. Mr. Sandeep Kothari, learned counsel 
for respondent No.3.
4. Vide this Court’s order dated 
30.12.2024, petitioner was permitted to 
serve respondent Nos.4 & 5 (College). But, 
instead of taking dasti notice from the 
office, ignorantly, petitioner serves 
respondent Nos.4 & 5 personally, which 
was received by respondents Nos.4 & 5. 
An affidavit to this effect is filed by the 
learned counsel for the petitioner before 
this Court, which is taken on record.
5. It is submitted by learned counsel for 
the petitioner that due to some untoward 
incident in the College, the petitioner was 
expelled from the College on 10.10.2024, 
however, after her expulsion, the 
respondent-College has accepted the 
enrolment fees of Rs.19,200/- from her.
6. In this view of the matter, since
despite service, no one appears for 
respondent Nos.4 & 5 and the examination 
is scheduled to be held on 02.01.2025,
therefore, as an interim measure, this 
Court provides that the respondent Nos.4  2
& 5 shall permit the petitioner to appear in 
M.D.(1st Year) examination provisionally.
7. Respondents are directed to file 
counter affidavit within a period of six 
weeks.
8. Two weeks’ time, thereafter, is 
granted to petitioner to file rejoinder 
affidavit.
9. Put up on 03.03.2025.
10. However, the result of the petitioner 
shall be declared only after the leave of 
this Court.
11. Let a certified copy of this order be 
supplied to the parties today itself, as per 
Rules.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 31.12.2024
PN
